title: Robata-Style Lechon Belly Adobo
description: A gluten-free twist on the classic Filipino dish, this Robata-style recipe uses a flavorful adobo sauce to marinate tender lechon belly.
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
In a blender or food processor, combine coconut vinegar, peanut oil, onion, garlic, and black pepper.
Blend until smooth and adjust seasoning to taste.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blended sauce, lechon belly, and a pinch of salt.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
Remove the lechon belly from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill the lechon belly for 5-7 minutes per side, or until caramelized and cooked through.
Transfer the lechon belly to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with steamed rice and your favorite Filipino sides.
